coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Strata at Mission Bay
record.summary: Strata at Mission Bay is a roughly 192-193 unit apartment building at 555 Mission Rock St; DBI records its construction permit complete on 2009-07-15 and DataSF Assessor records give 2009 as the building's year built; SocketSite's January 29, 2009 post said its units would come online in March 2009 (an expected date), and its August 31, 2009 post, citing the San Francisco Business Times, said the 192-unit building was fully leased after renting 90 apartments over the previous two months.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8711033 (6,097 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 194 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lots 8711028 and 8711033 and 192 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8711028)); 97% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 98% of the lot.

changes.text: The $12,000,000 figure is the valuation on the building permit, not a verified construction cost.
Notes on pages that could not be read are now plain statements, and mapping-process detail is left to the shape's own notes. No change to the record's status or shape.
The summary for Strata at Mission Bay now includes 2009 leasing reports.
Strata at Mission Bay now uses its Assessor lot lines.

Insomnia Cookies at 1215 4th St is still shown as open, but no readable page confirms it. DataSF lists two registrations by the same owner: 1215 4th St from February 2022 with no end date, and 1201 4th St from December 2021 to September 17, 2025. A registration does not show a storefront operating, and the 2025 end date could mean a closure or an address change.
Added 2 photos taken on site on September 30, 2026.
Strata's 2009 move-in note now cites the SocketSite post it came from, a reader's report of February 3, 2009.

Strata's map notes called it a 5-story building; OSM, the DBI permit and the Assessor all say 8 stories. The March 2009 completion date rested on SocketSite's forecast that units would come online then (a later SocketSite piece said move-ins had 'a long way to go'); it now cites DBI's permit completed 2009-07-15 and the Assessor's year built 2009 and says no source confirms move-in. Teappo was listed as an open tenant at 1225 4th St Unit 616, but its website is an online store with no storefront and 1225 4th St is The UPS Store's address, so it was removed from the tenant list and its earlier entry now says it is not a confirmed tenant. The One Medical and UPS Store entries now say their link to Strata comes from geocoding a business registration, not from the cited page. Insomnia Cookies could not be re-checked (Yelp blocks automated fetches) and is noted as unconfirmed. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural.

changes.text: Backfilled a $12M construction-cost figure for Strata from a DataSF DBI permit.
Insomnia Cookies operates a late-night bakery at 1215 4th St, the ground floor of the Strata at Mission Bay apartment building. No opening date found.

One Medical operates a primary care clinic at 1285 4th St, an address whose DataSF business-registration point falls inside the Strata at Mission Bay building footprint (the cited page does not name Strata). No opening date found; confirmed via One Medical's own location page.

The UPS Store #6609 operates a shipping, printing and mailbox service at 1225 4th St, an address whose DataSF business-registration point falls inside the Strata at Mission Bay building footprint (the cited page does not name Strata). No opening date found; confirmed via The UPS Store's own location page.

Teappo (shopteappo.com) is an online store with no street address or storefront on its site. A business registration lists it at 1225 4th St Unit 616, which is the address of The UPS Store #6609 (registrations there use unit/PMB numbers), so no storefront is shown and Teappo is not a confirmed tenant of Strata at Mission Bay.

open_questions: DataSF Assessor lists 193 units for this parcel versus the 192 reported by SocketSite and repeated across apartment-listing sites; the one-unit gap (possibly a manager's unit or a later modification) is not resolved.
Exact first move-in date is not confirmed from a primary source: the 'March 1st' date comes from a reader's report that SocketSite published on February 3, 2009, not from the developer.
Developer/architect not confirmed from any source checked as of 2026-09-21.
No opening date found for Insomnia Cookies (1215 4th St): checked its own Yelp listing and site for a firm date; Pier & Point's retail table also lists no opening date.
No opening date found for One Medical (1285 4th St): checked its own location page for a firm date; Pier & Point's retail table also lists no opening date.
No opening date found for The UPS Store #6609 (1225 4th St): checked its own location page for a firm date; Pier & Point's retail table also lists no opening date.

Teappo was removed from the retail table: shopteappo.com is an online Shopify store with no address or storefront. 1225 4th St is The UPS Store #6609's address, and DataSF business registrations there use unit/PMB numbers, so 'Unit 616' is not evidence of a storefront.

Insomnia Cookies (1215 4th St) has not been re-confirmed as open. Its Yelp listing could not be read (access refused on 2026-10-12), and its own store page loads only a script-driven app with no store details. DataSF shows two registrations by the same owner (Baked San Francisco Ca Operators LLC): 1215 4th St from 2022-02-16 with no end date, and 1201 4th St from 2021-12-16 to 2025-09-17. A registration is not evidence of an operating storefront, and the 2025 end date at 1201 4th St could mean a closure or a change of address; no source read says which.
